C Cin VIN1 n1
C Cf n1 n2
R Rf n2 VSS
NMOS M1 n3 n2 VSS VSS
L Ld VDD n3
C Cout n3 VOUT1
C Cfb n3 VSS
rationale: The proposed topology improves the binding constraints—particularly S21_ripple_db and S11_max_db—by adding a shunt peaking capacitor at the output node to enhance bandwidth and flatten the gain response, while simultaneously improving input match through the introduction of a capacitive feedback path that stabilizes the input reflection. This is critical in a wideband, inductorless LNA where gain ripple and input mismatch are the dominant failure modes. The added Cfb provides frequency-dependent feedback that counteracts the inherent roll-off and peaking in the gain profile, reducing ripple and pushing S11 toward the required -15 dB across 0.5–3 GHz. The topology remains inductorless and within budget, with minimal impact on power and noise.
